tools.description: Read one section of a .tex file by its title: from its heading to the next heading at the same or a shallower level, stopping before trailing matter such as \\appendix, the bibliography or \\end{document}.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the .tex file relative to the project root, e.g. main.tex.

parameters.name: sectionTitle
parameters.description: Section title exactly as it appears inside the sectioning command, e.g. Introduction for \\section{Introduction}. Call list_sections first if unsure.

tools.name: reject_tracked_changes
tools.desc: Reject suggestions in a document: a suggested insertion is removed and a suggested deletion puts the original text back.
tools.description: Reject suggestions in a document: a suggested insertion is removed and a suggested deletion puts the original text back.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.desc: Replace an exact snippet of text in a project file. Prefer it over write_file and edit_section for a targeted change: no
tools.description: Replace an exact snippet of text in a project file. Prefer it over write_file and edit_section for a targeted change: nothing outside the snippet is touched.

parameters.name: findText
parameters.description: Exact text to find, matched literally including whitespace and newlines. Not a regular expression.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the project root.

parameters.name: replaceAll
parameters.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one match (default false). Only set this when replacing all of them is intended.

parameters.name: replaceWith
parameters.description: Text to put in its place. Empty string deletes the snippet.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.desc: Add a message to an existing review-panel comment thread, under your account
tools.description: Add a message to an existing review-panel comment thread, under your account

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The reply, as it should appear in the thread.

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.desc: Mark a review-panel comment thread as resolved, or reopen a resolved one with reopen: true.
tools.description: Mark a review-panel comment thread as resolved, or reopen a resolved one with reopen: true.

parameters.name: reopen
parameters.description: Reopen a resolved thread instead of resolving an open one.

tools.name: restore_file
tools.desc: Put one file back to exactly what it was at an earlier revision, binary files included; a file deleted since then is bro
tools.description: Put one file back to exactly what it was at an earlier revision, binary files included; a file deleted since then is brought back.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path of the file to restore, relative to the project root, e.g. sections/intro.tex.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Commit hash to restore the file from, as list_history prints it.

tools.name: search_project
tools.desc: Search the project
tools.description: Search the project

parameters.name: isRegularExpression
parameters.description: Treat query as a regular expression instead of literal text (default false).

parameters.name: maximumMatches
parameters.description: Stop after this many matches, between 1 and 500 (default 100).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What to look for. Literal text by default, so LaTeX backslashes need no escaping; a regular expression when isRegularExpression is true.

tools.name: show_diff
tools.desc: Without revisions: a unified diff of everything in one project
tools.description: Without revisions: a unified diff of everything in one project

parameters.name: fromRevision
parameters.description: Compare history from this commit hash instead of showing pending local changes.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only this file or directory, relative to the project root. Omit for the whole project.

tools.name: suggest_edit
tools.desc: Replace an exact snippet of text so that it arrives in Overleaf as a tracked change a co-author can accept or reject, ra
tools.description: Replace an exact snippet of text so that it arrives in Overleaf as a tracked change a co-author can accept or reject, rather than as finished text.

parameters.name: findText
parameters.description: Exact text to replace, matched literally including whitespace. Must occur exactly once in the document.

parameters.name: replaceWith
parameters.description: Suggested replacement text. Empty string suggests deleting findText and nothing more.

tools.name: sync_project
tools.desc: Pull the latest commits from Overleaf into one project
tools.description: Pull the latest commits from Overleaf into one project

tools.name: upload_file
tools.desc: Add a file to the project byte for byte, such as a figure, a PDF, a data file or a .bib from elsewhere: copied from a pa
tools.description: Add a file to the project byte for byte, such as a figure, a PDF, a data file or a .bib from elsewhere: copied from a path on this computer, or decoded from base64. write_file is for text written in the call itself.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Where the file goes in the project, relative to the project root, e.g. figures/plot.png.

parameters.name: sourcePath
parameters.description: Absolute path of the file on this computer to copy, e.g. /Users/me/results/plot.png.

tools.name: verify_citations
tools.desc: Look up the bibliography entries a document cites, to catch references that point at the wrong work or at nothing, such
tools.description: Look up the bibliography entries a document cites, to catch references that point at the wrong work or at nothing, such as a mistyped DOI or a citation made up by a model.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Citation keys to look up, cited or not. Omit to look up the cited entries in citation order.

parameters.name: maximumEntries
parameters.description: Look up at most this many entries, between 1 and 100 (default ${DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_ENTRIES}); the reply says how many were left.

tools.name: write_file
tools.desc: Write a whole file: create it, with any missing parent directories, or overwrite it entirely.
tools.description: Write a whole file: create it, with any missing parent directories, or overwrite it entirely.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The complete new contents of the file, not a fragment to append.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the project root, e.g. sections/related-work.tex. Must stay inside the project.
